result.question: What was the old prophet’s answer to the man of God?

readings.answer: He said he too was a prophet and that an angel told him by the word of the LORD to bring the man back to his house to eat bread and drink water.
readings.support: I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’

assessments.reason: It matches verse 18 that the old prophet said an angel told him by the word of the LORD to bring the man back to his house to eat bread and drink water; adding that he too was a prophet is accurate extra detail from the passage.

result.reason: The reading accurately reflects the old prophet’s claim that an angel told him to bring the man back to eat and drink.
